Warskeleton.description: Constructed from military remains with heavy bone structure.

features.name: Warskull Skeleton
features.tldr: You gain additional hit points and heavier physical resistance to physical weapons.

Fleet.description: Stripped down to lightweight bones built for speed and swift evasion.

features.name: Fleet Skeleton
features.tldr: Your base speed increases by 5 feet, allowing rapid movement across the battlefield.
